sentence: Learning dexterous bimanual manipulation policies critically depends on large-scale, high-quality demonstrations, yet current paradigms face inherent trade-offs: teleoperation provides physically grounded data but is prohibitively labor-intensive, while simulation-based synthesis scales efficiently but suffers from sim-to-real gaps.

title: One-Shot Real-World Demonstration Synthesis for Scalable Bimanual Manipulation
sentence: We present BiDemoSyn, a framework that synthesizes contact-rich, physically feasible bimanual demonstrations from a single real-world example.

title: One-Shot Real-World Demonstration Synthesis for Scalable Bimanual Manipulation

title: One-Shot Real-World Demonstration Synthesis for Scalable Bimanual Manipulation
sentence: This enables the generation of thousands of diverse and feasible demonstrations within several hour, without repeated teleoperation or reliance on imperfect simulation.

title: One-Shot Real-World Demonstration Synthesis for Scalable Bimanual Manipulation
sentence: Across six dual-arm tasks, we show that policies trained on BiDemoSyn data generalize robustly to novel object poses and shapes, significantly outperforming recent strong baselines.

title: One-Shot Real-World Demonstration Synthesis for Scalable Bimanual Manipulation
sentence: Beyond the one-shot setting, BiDemoSyn naturally extends to few-shot-based synthesis, improving object-level diversity and out-of-distribution generalization while maintaining strong data efficiency.

title: One-Shot Real-World Demonstration Synthesis for Scalable Bimanual Manipulation
sentence: Moreover, policies trained on BiDemoSyn data exhibit zero-shot cross-embodiment transfer to new robotic platforms, enabled by object-centric observations and a simplified 6-DoF end-effector action representation that decouples policies from embodiment-specific dynamics.

title: One-Shot Real-World Demonstration Synthesis for Scalable Bimanual Manipulation
sentence: By bridging the gap between efficiency and real-world fidelity, BiDemoSyn provides a scalable path toward practical imitation learning for complex bimanual manipulation without compromising physical grounding.

title: Supervised Mixture-of-Experts for Surgical Grasping and Retraction
sentence: Imitation learning has achieved remarkable success in robotic manipulation, yet its application to surgical robotics remains challenging due to data scarcity, constrained workspaces, and the need for an exceptional level of safety and predictability.

title: Supervised Mixture-of-Experts for Surgical Grasping and Retraction

title: Supervised Mixture-of-Experts for Surgical Grasping and Retraction
sentence: Unlike prior surgical robot learning approaches that rely on multi-camera setups or thousands of demonstrations, we show that a lightweight action decoder policy like Action Chunking Transformer (ACT) can learn complex, long-horizon manipulation from less than 150 demonstrations using solely stereo endoscopic images, when equipped with our architecture.

title: Supervised Mixture-of-Experts for Surgical Grasping and Retraction
sentence: We evaluate our approach on the collaborative surgical task of bowel grasping and retraction, where a robot assistant interprets visual cues from a human surgeon, executes targeted grasping on deformable tissue, and performs sustained retraction.

sentence: We benchmark our method against state-of-the-art Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and the standard ACT baseline.

sentence: Notably, it generalizes to unseen testing viewpoints and also transfers zero-shot to ex vivo porcine tissue without additional training, offering a promising pathway toward in vivo deployment.

title: DexImit: Learning Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation from Monocular Human Videos
sentence: Data scarcity fundamentally limits the generalization of bimanual dexterous manipulation, as real-world data collection for dexterous hands is expensive and labor-intensive.

title: DexImit: Learning Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation from Monocular Human Videos
sentence: Human manipulation videos, as a direct carrier of manipulation knowledge, offer significant potential for scaling up robot learning.

title: DexImit: Learning Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation from Monocular Human Videos

title: DexImit: Learning Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation from Monocular Human Videos

title: DexImit: Learning Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation from Monocular Human Videos
sentence: DexImit employs a four-stage generation pipeline: (1) reconstructing hand–object interactions from arbitrary viewpoints with near-metric scale; (2) performing subtask decomposition and bimanual scheduling; (3) synthesizing robot trajectories consistent with the demonstrated interactions; (4) comprehensive data augmentation for zero-shot real-world deployment.

title: DexImit: Learning Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation from Monocular Human Videos

title: DexImit: Learning Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation from Monocular Human Videos
sentence: DexImit is capable of handling diverse manipulation tasks, including tool use (e.g., cutting an apple), long-horizon tasks (e.g., making a beverage), and fine-grained manipulations (e.g., stacking cups).

title: Semantic Contact Fields for Category-Level Generalizable Tool Manipulation

title: Semantic Contact Fields for Category-Level Generalizable Tool Manipulation

title: Semantic Contact Fields for Category-Level Generalizable Tool Manipulation

title: Semantic Contact Fields for Category-Level Generalizable Tool Manipulation

title: Semantic Contact Fields for Category-Level Generalizable Tool Manipulation
sentence: This allows physical generalization to unseen tools.

title: Semantic Contact Fields for Category-Level Generalizable Tool Manipulation

title: Contact-Grounded Policy: Dexterous Visuotactile Policy with Generative Contact Grounding
sentence: Contact-rich dexterous manipulation with multi-finger hands remains an open challenge in robotics because task success depends on multi-point contacts that continuously evolve and are highly sensitive to object geometry, frictional transitions, and slip.

title: Contact-Grounded Policy: Dexterous Visuotactile Policy with Generative Contact Grounding
sentence: Recently, tactile-informed manipulation policies have shown promise.

title: Contact-Grounded Policy: Dexterous Visuotactile Policy with Generative Contact Grounding

title: Contact-Grounded Policy: Dexterous Visuotactile Policy with Generative Contact Grounding
sentence: We present Contact-Grounded Policy (CGP), a visuotactile policy that grounds multi-point contacts by predicting coupled trajectories of actual robot state and tactile feedback, and using a learned contact-consistency mapping to convert these predictions into executable target robot states for a compliance controller.

title: Contact-Grounded Policy: Dexterous Visuotactile Policy with Generative Contact Grounding
sentence: CGP consists of two components: (i) a conditional diffusion model that forecasts future robot state and tactile feedback in a compressed latent space, and (ii) a learned contact-consistency mapping that converts the predicted robot state-tactile pair into executable targets for a compliance controller, enabling it to realize the intended contacts.

title: Contact-Grounded Policy: Dexterous Visuotactile Policy with Generative Contact Grounding
sentence: We evaluate CGP using a physical four-finger Allegro V5 hand with Digit360 fingertip tactile sensors, and a simulated five-finger Tesollo DG-5F hand with dense whole-hand tactile arrays.

title: Contact-Grounded Policy: Dexterous Visuotactile Policy with Generative Contact Grounding
sentence: Across a range of dexterous tasks including in-hand manipulation, delicate grasping, and tool use, CGP outperforms visuomotor and visuotactile diffusion-policy baselines.

title: TactAlign: Human-to-Robot Policy Transfer via Tactile Alignment
sentence: Human demonstrations collected by wearable devices (e.g., tactile gloves) provide fast and dexterous supervision for policy learning, and are guided by rich, natural tactile feedback.

title: TactAlign: Human-to-Robot Policy Transfer via Tactile Alignment
sentence: However, a key challenge is how to transfer human-collected tactile signals to robots despite the differences in sensing modalities and embodiment.

title: TactAlign: Human-to-Robot Policy Transfer via Tactile Alignment
sentence: Existing human-to-robot (H2R) approaches that incorporate touch often assume identical tactile sensors, require paired data, and involve little to no embodiment gap between human demonstrator and the robots, limiting scalability and generality.

title: TactAlign: Human-to-Robot Policy Transfer via Tactile Alignment
sentence: We propose TactAlign, a cross-embodiment tactile alignment method that transfers human-collected tactile signals to a robot with different embodiment.

title: TactAlign: Human-to-Robot Policy Transfer via Tactile Alignment

title: TactAlign: Human-to-Robot Policy Transfer via Tactile Alignment

title: TactAlign: Human-to-Robot Policy Transfer via Tactile Alignment

sentence: Our study leverages 4,000 hours of robot and human manipulation data and 50M vision–language samples to train vision-language-action (VLA) policies.

title: A Systematic Study of Data Modalities and Strategies for Co-training Large Behavior Models for Robot Manipulation

title: A Systematic Study of Data Modalities and Strategies for Co-training Large Behavior Models for Robot Manipulation

title: UMI-Underwater: Learning Underwater Manipulation without Underwater Teleoperation

title: UMI-Underwater: Learning Underwater Manipulation without Underwater Teleoperation
sentence: We introduce a system that (i) autonomously collects successful underwater grasp demonstrations via a self-supervised data collection pipeline and (ii) transfers grasp knowledge from on-land human demonstrations through a depth-based affordance representation that bridges the on-land–to–underwater domain gap and is robust to lighting and color shift.

title: UMI-Underwater: Learning Underwater Manipulation without Underwater Teleoperation
sentence: In pool experiments, our approach improves grasping performance and robustness to background shifts, and enables generalization to objects seen only in on-land data, outperforming RGB-only baselines.

title: RAG-Diff: Adapting Diffusion Policies to Dynamic Constraints with Retrieval-Augmented Guidance

title: RAG-Diff: Adapting Diffusion Policies to Dynamic Constraints with Retrieval-Augmented Guidance

title: RAG-Diff: Adapting Diffusion Policies to Dynamic Constraints with Retrieval-Augmented Guidance
sentence: We further conducted real-world user studies on the bed-bathing task.

sentence: Results show that RAG-Diff improves both task success and constraint satisfaction compared to a range of baselines, including unguided diffusion and other guidance- or sampling-based variants.

title: HAIC: Humanoid Agile Object Interaction Control via Dynamics-Aware World Model

sentence: While foundation models provide strong zero-shot recognition, their predictions are intermittent and view-dependent, and naively integrating them into mapping pipelines leads to identity drift and stale semantics over time.

title: SuperMap: A Spatio-Temporal SLAM System for Visual-Language Navigation
sentence: We present SuperMap, a 4D spatio-temporal mapping framework for language-guided navigation that integrates high-frequency geometric SLAM with asynchronous open-vocabulary perception.

title: SuperMap: A Spatio-Temporal SLAM System for Visual-Language Navigation
sentence: Our core contribution is a consistency-driven mapping engine that combines 3D-aware instance association/re-activation with a principled existence-and-label confidence update to maintain stable object identities and prune outdated map content under occlusions and scene changes.

title: SuperMap: A Spatio-Temporal SLAM System for Visual-Language Navigation
sentence: SuperMap produces a queryable 4D scene-graph representation that interfaces naturally with Vision-Language Models by supporting compositional queries over object semantics, relations, and history.

title: SuperMap: A Spatio-Temporal SLAM System for Visual-Language Navigation
sentence: We demonstrate SuperMap on benchmarks and real robots, including dynamic scenes with appearance/disappearance and relocation, and provide ablations and runtime analysis.

title: SuperMap: A Spatio-Temporal SLAM System for Visual-Language Navigation
sentence: We release the full system as open-source to provide the community with a deployable baseline for open-vocabulary spatio-temporal mapping.

title: Provably Guaranteed Polytopic Uncertainty Quantification for SLAM
sentence: In safety-critical robotics applications, guaranteed and practical uncertainty quantification (UQ) in perception is vital.

title: Provably Guaranteed Polytopic Uncertainty Quantification for SLAM
sentence: Many existing works either offer no formal containment guarantee, rely on restrictive modeling assumptions, or focus only on pose estimation rather than a complete SLAM pipeline.

title: Provably Guaranteed Polytopic Uncertainty Quantification for SLAM
sentence: This paper presents provably guaranteed UQ algorithms for 3D-3D landmark-based SLAM.

title: Provably Guaranteed Polytopic Uncertainty Quantification for SLAM
sentence: The algorithms consist of three basic UQ modules: forward UQ for mapping, backward UQ for pose tracking, and pose compound.

title: Provably Guaranteed Polytopic Uncertainty Quantification for SLAM
sentence: Each module produces a certified uncertainty set; when the input uncertainty bounds are deterministic, the output sets inherit deterministic guarantees, i.e., they provably contain the true poses and landmarks.

title: Provably Guaranteed Polytopic Uncertainty Quantification for SLAM
sentence: Specifically, we use polytopes to represent uncertainty sets, enabling tractable computations and a unified treatment of pose uncertainty.

title: Provably Guaranteed Polytopic Uncertainty Quantification for SLAM
sentence: To enhance algorithms’ practical usability, we incorporate conformal prediction to calibrate measurement uncertainty from data with prescribed probability.

title: Provably Guaranteed Polytopic Uncertainty Quantification for SLAM
sentence: Simulations and experiments demonstrate that the proposed algorithms provide both strong theoretical guarantees and practical usability.

title: CoRAL: Contact-Rich Adaptive LLM-based Control for Robotic Manipulation
sentence: While Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) demonstrate remarkable capabilities in high-level reasoning and semantic understanding, applying them directly to contact-rich manipulation remains a challenge due to their lack of explicit physical grounding and inability to perform adaptive control.

title: CoRAL: Contact-Rich Adaptive LLM-based Control for Robotic Manipulation
sentence: To bridge this gap, we propose CoRAL (Contact-Rich Adaptive LLM-based control), a modular framework that enables zero-shot planning by decoupling high-level reasoning from low-level control.

title: CoRAL: Contact-Rich Adaptive LLM-based Control for Robotic Manipulation
sentence: Unlike black-box policies, CoRAL utilizes Large Language Models (LLMs) not as direct controllers, but as cost designers that synthesize context-aware objective functions for a sampling-based motion planner (MPPI).

title: CoRAL: Contact-Rich Adaptive LLM-based Control for Robotic Manipulation
sentence: To address the ambiguity of physical parameters in visual data, we introduce a neuro-symbolic adaptation loop: a Vision-Language Model provides semantic priors for environmental dynamics (e.g., mass, friction estimates), which are then explicitly refined in real-time via online system identification, while the LLM iteratively modulates the cost function structure to correct strategic errors based on interaction feedback.

title: CoRAL: Contact-Rich Adaptive LLM-based Control for Robotic Manipulation
sentence: Furthermore, a retrieval-based memory unit allows the system to reuse successful strategies across recurrent tasks.

title: CoRAL: Contact-Rich Adaptive LLM-based Control for Robotic Manipulation
sentence: This hierarchical architecture ensures real-time control stability by decoupling high-level semantic reasoning from reactive execution, effectively bridging the gap between slow LLM inference and dynamic contact requirements.

title: CoRAL: Contact-Rich Adaptive LLM-based Control for Robotic Manipulation
sentence: We validate CoRAL on both simulation and real-world hardware across challenging and novel tasks, such as “flipping objects against walls” leveraging extrinsic contacts.

title: CoRAL: Contact-Rich Adaptive LLM-based Control for Robotic Manipulation
sentence: Experiments demonstrate that CoRAL outperforms state-of-the-art VLA and foundation-model-based planner baselines by boosting success rates over 50% on average in unseen contact-rich scenarios, effectively handling sim-to-real gaps through its adaptive physical understanding.

title: GHOST: Hierarchical Sub-Goal Policies for Generalizing Robot Manipulation
sentence: We present GHOST, a framework for learning visuomotor manipulation policies that generalize beyond the training distribution.

title: GHOST: Hierarchical Sub-Goal Policies for Generalizing Robot Manipulation
sentence: GHOST factorizes control into (i) a high-level policy that predicts the next sub-goal as a distribution over 3D end-effector poses from multi-view RGB-D observations, and (ii) a low-level goal-conditioned controller that executes embodiment-specific actions.

title: GHOST: Hierarchical Sub-Goal Policies for Generalizing Robot Manipulation
sentence: To condition image-based policies on 3D goals, we introduce a simple spatial interface that projects predicted goals into the image plane and represents them as end-effector heatmaps.

title: GHOST: Hierarchical Sub-Goal Policies for Generalizing Robot Manipulation
sentence: Across a suite of manipulation tasks, this hierarchical factorization consistently improves performance and robustness compared to a flat Diffusion Policy.

title: GHOST: Hierarchical Sub-Goal Policies for Generalizing Robot Manipulation
sentence: Further, we show that this hierarchical interface also makes it easy to incorporate human demonstrations without relying on (noisy) action retargeting.

title: GHOST: Hierarchical Sub-Goal Policies for Generalizing Robot Manipulation
sentence: As sub-goals are largely embodiment-agnostic, we train the high-level policy on human video to specify how learned skills should be applied and composed, while keeping the low-level policy trained purely on robot data.

title: GHOST: Hierarchical Sub-Goal Policies for Generalizing Robot Manipulation
sentence: This hierarchy enables adaptation to novel objects and task variations using a small number of human demonstrations.

title: Robo3R: Enhancing Robotic Manipulation with Accurate Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
sentence: 3D spatial perception is fundamental to generalizable robotic manipulation, yet obtaining reliable, high-quality 3D geometry remains challenging.

title: Robo3R: Enhancing Robotic Manipulation with Accurate Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
sentence: Depth sensors suffer from noise and material sensitivity, while existing reconstruction models lack the precision and metric consistency required for physical interaction.

title: Robo3R: Enhancing Robotic Manipulation with Accurate Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
sentence: We introduce Robo3R, a feed-forward, manipulation-ready 3D reconstruction model that predicts accurate, metric-scale scene geometry directly from RGB images and robot states in real time.

title: Robo3R: Enhancing Robotic Manipulation with Accurate Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
sentence: Robo3R jointly infers scale-invariant local geometry and relative camera poses, which are unified into the scene representation in the canonical robot frame via a learned global similarity transformation.

title: Robo3R: Enhancing Robotic Manipulation with Accurate Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
sentence: To meet the precision demands of manipulation, Robo3R employs a masked point head for sharp, fine-grained point clouds, and a keypoint-based Perspective-n-Point (PnP) formulation to refine camera extrinsics and global alignment.

title: Robo3R: Enhancing Robotic Manipulation with Accurate Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
sentence: Trained on Robo3R-4M, a curated large-scale synthetic dataset with four million high-fidelity annotated frames, Robo3R consistently outperforms state-of-the-art reconstruction methods and depth sensors.

title: Robo3R: Enhancing Robotic Manipulation with Accurate Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
sentence: Across downstream tasks including imitation learning, sim-to-real transfer, grasp synthesis, and collision-free motion planning, we observe consistent gains in performance, suggesting the promise of this alternative 3D sensing module for robotic manipulation.

title: Semantically Structured Mixture-of-Experts for Compositional Robotic Manipulation
sentence: Diffusion-based policies have established a new standard for precise robotic manipulation but face a critical scalability bottleneck: high-performance models are computationally expensive, while lightweight alternatives often fail to generalize across diverse multi-task environments.

title: Semantically Structured Mixture-of-Experts for Compositional Robotic Manipulation
sentence: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures offer a promising path to efficiency by activating only a subset of parameters.

title: Semantically Structured Mixture-of-Experts for Compositional Robotic Manipulation
sentence: However, existing MoE routing mechanisms typically rely on low-level noise or latent statistics, ignoring the compositional nature of manipulation tasks.

title: Semantically Structured Mixture-of-Experts for Compositional Robotic Manipulation
sentence: This results in redundant experts that fail to capture reusable skills, limiting both interpretability and transfer.

title: Semantically Structured Mixture-of-Experts for Compositional Robotic Manipulation
sentence: We introduce Semantically Structured Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Policy for Compositional Robotic Manipulation (SMoDP), a framework that grounds expert specialization in semantic task structure.

title: Semantically Structured Mixture-of-Experts for Compositional Robotic Manipulation
sentence: SMoDP leverages a lightweight, inference-time skill predictor—distilled from offline VLM annotations—to route action chunks to experts specialized for specific behavioral phases.

title: Semantically Structured Mixture-of-Experts for Compositional Robotic Manipulation
sentence: To ensure robust assignment, we propose a dual contrastive alignment strategy that grounds multi-modal observations in language-defined skill semantics (Inter-modal) while enforcing routing consistency across visually distinct but functionally identical behaviors (Intra-modal).

title: Semantically Structured Mixture-of-Experts for Compositional Robotic Manipulation
sentence: Our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on multi-task benchmarks with significantly improved parameter efficiency and demonstrates effective compositional transfer to novel tasks through parameter-efficient fine-tuning.

title: Learning Native Continuation for Action Chunking Flow Policies
sentence: Action chunking enables Vision Language Action (VLA) models to run in real time, but naive chunked execution often exhibits discontinuities at chunk boundaries.

title: Learning Native Continuation for Action Chunking Flow Policies
sentence: Real-Time Chunking (RTC) alleviates this issue but is external to the policy, leading to spurious multimodal switching and trajectories that are not intrinsically smooth.

title: Learning Native Continuation for Action Chunking Flow Policies
sentence: We propose Legato, a training-time continuation method for action-chunked flow-based VLA policies.

title: Learning Native Continuation for Action Chunking Flow Policies
sentence: Specifically, Legato initializes denoising from a schedule-shaped mixture of known actions and noise, exposing the model to partial action information.

title: Learning Native Continuation for Action Chunking Flow Policies
sentence: Moreover, Legato reshapes the learned flow dynamics to ensure that the denoising process remains consistent between training and inference under per-step guidance.

title: Learning Native Continuation for Action Chunking Flow Policies
sentence: Legato further uses randomized schedule condition during training to support varying inference delays and achieve controllable smoothness.

title: Learning Native Continuation for Action Chunking Flow Policies
sentence: Empirically, Legato produces smoother trajectories and reduces spurious multimodal switching during execution, leading to less hesitation and shorter task completion time.

title: Learning Native Continuation for Action Chunking Flow Policies
sentence: Extensive real-world experiments show that Legato consistently outperforms RTC across five manipulation tasks, achieving approximately 10% improvements in both trajectory smoothness and task completion time.

title: DexEvolve: Evolutionary Optimization for Robust and Diverse Dexterous Grasp Synthesis
sentence: Dexterous grasping is fundamental to robotics, yet data-driven grasp prediction heavily relies on large, diverse datasets that are costly to generate and typically limited to a narrow set of gripper morphologies.

title: DexEvolve: Evolutionary Optimization for Robust and Diverse Dexterous Grasp Synthesis
sentence: Analytical grasp synthesis can be used to scale data collection, but necessary simplifying assumptions often yield physically infeasible grasps that need to be filtered in high-fidelity simulators, significantly reducing the total number of grasps and their diversity.

title: DexEvolve: Evolutionary Optimization for Robust and Diverse Dexterous Grasp Synthesis
sentence: We propose a scalable generate-and-refine pipeline for synthesizing large-scale, diverse, and physically feasible grasps.

title: DexEvolve: Evolutionary Optimization for Robust and Diverse Dexterous Grasp Synthesis
sentence: Instead of using high-fidelity simulators solely for verification and filtering, we leverage them as an optimization stage that continuously improves grasp quality without discarding precomputed candidates.

title: DexEvolve: Evolutionary Optimization for Robust and Diverse Dexterous Grasp Synthesis
sentence: More specifically, we initialize an evolutionary search with a seed set of analytically generated, potentially suboptimal grasps.

title: DexEvolve: Evolutionary Optimization for Robust and Diverse Dexterous Grasp Synthesis
sentence: We then refine these proposals directly in a high-fidelity simulator (Isaac Sim) using an asynchronous, gradient-free evolutionary algorithm, improving stability while maintaining diversity.

title: DexEvolve: Evolutionary Optimization for Robust and Diverse Dexterous Grasp Synthesis
sentence: In addition, this refinement stage can be guided toward human preferences and/or domain-specific quality metrics without requiring a differentiable objective.

title: DexEvolve: Evolutionary Optimization for Robust and Diverse Dexterous Grasp Synthesis
sentence: We further distill the refined grasp distribution into a diffusion model for robust real-world deployment, and highlight the role of diversity for both effective training and during deployment.

title: DexEvolve: Evolutionary Optimization for Robust and Diverse Dexterous Grasp Synthesis
sentence: Experiments on a newly introduced Handles dataset and a DexGraspNet subset demonstrate that our approach achieves over 120 distinct stable grasps per object (a 1.7-6x improvement over unrefined analytical methods) while outperforming diffusion-based alternatives by 46-60% in unique grasp coverage.

title: TACTIC: Tactile and Vision Conditioned Contact-Centric Control for Whole-Arm Manipulation
sentence: Whole-arm manipulation involves direct contact with the environment while the robot completes a task by distributing contact across multiple links as contacts form, slide, and break.

title: TACTIC: Tactile and Vision Conditioned Contact-Centric Control for Whole-Arm Manipulation
sentence: This setting breaks common implicit assumptions in many learning-based manipulation pipelines: arm configuration tightly couples motion and contact forces, contact state is partially observed under occlusion, and purely learned rollouts can become physically inconsistent under distribution shift because many multi-link contact configurations are sparsely represented in the data.

title: TACTIC: Tactile and Vision Conditioned Contact-Centric Control for Whole-Arm Manipulation
sentence: To address this, we propose TACTIC (Tactile and Vision Conditioned Contact-Centric Control), a receding-horizon controller for whole-arm manipulation.

title: TACTIC: Tactile and Vision Conditioned Contact-Centric Control for Whole-Arm Manipulation
sentence: TACTIC uses a contact-centric hybrid predictive model that combines RGB-D, distributed tactile sensing, and a compact 2D proximity representation.

title: TACTIC: Tactile and Vision Conditioned Contact-Centric Control for Whole-Arm Manipulation
sentence: The model couples a learned, action-conditioned latent dynamics model with analytical kinematics through contact Jacobians, enabling rollouts of future contact configurations and interaction forces.

title: TACTIC: Tactile and Vision Conditioned Contact-Centric Control for Whole-Arm Manipulation
sentence: TACTIC integrates these rollouts into a sampling-based MPC planner with contact-aware action sampling: contact Jacobian-based projections steer sampled action sequences toward force-modulating directions, and objectives defined over predicted proximity and interaction forces trade task progress against whole-arm force regulation.

title: TACTIC: Tactile and Vision Conditioned Contact-Centric Control for Whole-Arm Manipulation
sentence: We evaluate TACTIC in simulation against state-of-the-art model-based and model-free methods, and perform ablations that isolate the contribution of each design choice.

title: TACTIC: Tactile and Vision Conditioned Contact-Centric Control for Whole-Arm Manipulation
sentence: Across experiments, TACTIC consistently outperforms other methods.

title: TACTIC: Tactile and Vision Conditioned Contact-Centric Control for Whole-Arm Manipulation
sentence: We further demonstrate real-world performance on a robot with distributed tactile sensing across three whole-arm manipulation tasks that require multi-contact trajectories: turning over and repositioning a manikin, and goal-reaching in a 3D dynamic maze.

title: Distributionally Robust Control via Stein Variational Inference for Contact-rich Manipulation
sentence: Reliable robotic manipulation requires control policies that can accurately represent and adapt to uncertainty arising from contact-rich interactions.

title: Distributionally Robust Control via Stein Variational Inference for Contact-rich Manipulation
sentence: Modern data-driven methods mitigate uncertainty through large-scale training and computation, and degrade significantly in performance with limited number of training samples.

title: Distributionally Robust Control via Stein Variational Inference for Contact-rich Manipulation
sentence: By contrast, classical model-based controllers are computationally efficient and reliable, but their limited ability to represent task-relevant uncertainty can hinder performance in contact-rich interactions.

title: Distributionally Robust Control via Stein Variational Inference for Contact-rich Manipulation
sentence: In this work, we propose to expand the capabilities of model-based manipulation control through more flexible uncertainty modeling that retains performance while exactly adapting to uncertainty.

title: Distributionally Robust Control via Stein Variational Inference for Contact-rich Manipulation
sentence: Our approach casts the manipulation problem as a distributionally robust control optimization and proposes a novel deterministic formulation based on Stein variational inference that preserves performance while explicitly modeling task-sensitive parameter uncertainty.

title: Distributionally Robust Control via Stein Variational Inference for Contact-rich Manipulation
sentence: As a result, the derived controllers are more aware of task sensitivities to uncertainty, yielding high reliability without compromising performance.

title: Distributionally Robust Control via Stein Variational Inference for Contact-rich Manipulation
sentence: Experimental results demonstrate up to 3× improved robustness across a range of contact-rich manipulation tasks under broad parametric uncertainty, outperforming existing model-based control methods.

title: PolaRiS: Scalable Real-to-Sim Evaluations for Generalist Robot Policies
sentence: A significant challenge for robot learning research is our ability to accurately measure and compare the performance of robot policies.

title: PolaRiS: Scalable Real-to-Sim Evaluations for Generalist Robot Policies
sentence: Benchmarking in robotics is historically challenging due to the stochasticity, reproducibility, and time-consuming nature of real-world rollouts.

title: PolaRiS: Scalable Real-to-Sim Evaluations for Generalist Robot Policies
sentence: This challenge is exacerbated for recent generalist policies, which have to be evaluated across a wide variety of scenes and tasks.

title: PolaRiS: Scalable Real-to-Sim Evaluations for Generalist Robot Policies
sentence: Evaluation in simulation offers a scalable complement to real world evaluations, but the visual and physical domain gap between existing simulation benchmarks and the real world has made them an unreliable signal for policy improvement.

title: PolaRiS: Scalable Real-to-Sim Evaluations for Generalist Robot Policies
sentence: Furthermore, building realistic and diverse simulated environments has traditionally required significant human effort and expertise.

title: PolaRiS: Scalable Real-to-Sim Evaluations for Generalist Robot Policies
sentence: To bridge the gap, we introduce Policy Evaluation and Environment Reconstruction in Simulation (PolaRiS), a scalable real-to-sim framework for high-fidelity simulated robot evaluation.

title: PolaRiS: Scalable Real-to-Sim Evaluations for Generalist Robot Policies
sentence: PolaRiS utilizes neural reconstruction methods to turn short video scans of real-world scenes into interactive simulation environments.

title: PolaRiS: Scalable Real-to-Sim Evaluations for Generalist Robot Policies
sentence: Additionally, we develop a simple simulation data co-training recipe that bridges remaining real-to-sim gaps and enables zero-shot evaluation in unseen simulation environments.

title: PolaRiS: Scalable Real-to-Sim Evaluations for Generalist Robot Policies
sentence: Through extensive paired evaluations, across 600 real-world rollouts and over 93,000 simulation rollouts, we demonstrate that PolaRiS evaluations provide a much stronger correlation to real world, non-finetuned generalist policy ranking than existing simulated benchmarks.

title: PolaRiS: Scalable Real-to-Sim Evaluations for Generalist Robot Policies
sentence: Its simplicity also enables rapid creation of diverse simulated environments.

title: PolaRiS: Scalable Real-to-Sim Evaluations for Generalist Robot Policies
sentence: As such, this work takes a step towards distributed and democratized evaluation for the next generation of robotic foundation models.

title: MVP-Nav: Multi-layer Value Map Planner Navigator
sentence: Zero-Shot Object Goal Navigation (ZSON) is an important task for robots.

title: MVP-Nav: Multi-layer Value Map Planner Navigator
sentence: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have empowered robots with significant semantic reasoning capabilities, current RGB-only navigation methods still struggle to align high-level discrete logic with low-level continuous physical execution, often due to a lack of explicit geometric constraints and spatial memory.

title: MVP-Nav: Multi-layer Value Map Planner Navigator
sentence: In this paper, we propose MVP-Nav (Multi-layer ValueMap Planner Navigator), a hierarchical framework designed for robust RGB-only ZSON.

title: MVP-Nav: Multi-layer Value Map Planner Navigator
sentence: Our approach utilizes a 3D foundation model to recover the physical scale and spatial occupancy of semantic instances from monocular observations, representing them as Oriented Bounding Boxes (OBB) within a dynamic Spatial Semantic List.

title: MVP-Nav: Multi-layer Value Map Planner Navigator
sentence: At the core of our system is the Multi-layer Value Maps (MVM) mechanism, which serves as a navigation hub: the MLLM acts as a high-level planner to assign semantic weights and determine navigation modes, while the low-level controller performs precise geometric path planning within a cost space fused with physical constraints.

title: MVP-Nav: Multi-layer Value Map Planner Navigator
sentence: Experimental results demonstrate that MVP-Nav achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) success rates and exploration efficiency among depth-free methods, even surpassing several depth-based benchmarks.

title: Self-Supervised Bootstrapping of Action-Predictive Embodied Reasoning
sentence: Embodied Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has significantly enhanced Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, yet current methods rely on rigid templates to specify reasoning primitives (e.g., objects in the scene, high-level plans, structural affordances).

title: Self-Supervised Bootstrapping of Action-Predictive Embodied Reasoning
sentence: These templates can force policies to process irrelevant information that distracts from critical action-prediction signals.

title: Self-Supervised Bootstrapping of Action-Predictive Embodied Reasoning
sentence: This creates a bottleneck: without successful policies, we cannot verify reasoning quality; without quality reasoning, we cannot build robust policies.

title: Self-Supervised Bootstrapping of Action-Predictive Embodied Reasoning
sentence: We introduce R&B-EnCoRe, which enables models to bootstrap embodied reasoning from internet-scale knowledge through self-supervised refinement.

title: Self-Supervised Bootstrapping of Action-Predictive Embodied Reasoning
sentence: By treating reasoning as a latent variable within importance-weighted variational inference, models can generate and distill a refined reasoning training dataset of embodiment-specific strategies without external rewards, verifiers, or human annotation.

title: Self-Supervised Bootstrapping of Action-Predictive Embodied Reasoning
sentence: We validate R&B-EnCoRe across manipulation (Franka Panda in simulation, WidowX in hardware), legged navigation (bipedal, wheeled, bicycle, quadruped), and autonomous driving embodiments using various VLA architectures with 1B, 4B, 7B, and 30B parameters.

title: Self-Supervised Bootstrapping of Action-Predictive Embodied Reasoning
sentence: Our approach achieves 28% gains in manipulation success, 101% improvement in navigation scores, and 21% reduction in collision-rate metric over models that indiscriminately reason about all available primitives.

title: Self-Supervised Bootstrapping of Action-Predictive Embodied Reasoning
sentence: R&B-EnCoRe enables models to distill reasoning that is predictive of successful control, bypassing manual annotation engineering while grounding internet-scale knowledge in physical execution.

title: D-Nav: End-to-End Dynamic UAV Navigation with Dual-Resolution Motion Awareness
sentence: Autonomous navigation in dense, dynamic clutter remains a fundamental challenge for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) due to the heterogeneous obstacle scales and complex motion patterns.

title: D-Nav: End-to-End Dynamic UAV Navigation with Dual-Resolution Motion Awareness
sentence: Existing methods often rely on fragile explicit tracking or noise-sensitive implicit flow estimation, both of which struggle with irregular geometries and real-time constraints.

title: D-Nav: End-to-End Dynamic UAV Navigation with Dual-Resolution Motion Awareness
sentence: We propose D-Nav, a novel end-to-end reinforcement learning framework that directly maps raw LiDAR observations to control actions through a saliency-driven dual-resolution spatio-temporal representation.

title: D-Nav: End-to-End Dynamic UAV Navigation with Dual-Resolution Motion Awareness
sentence: At the global level, D-Nav constructs a spatio-temporal spherical depth representation that encodes scene structure and motion trends directly from sequential LiDAR measurements.

title: D-Nav: End-to-End Dynamic UAV Navigation with Dual-Resolution Motion Awareness
sentence: Building on this global context, a saliency-based refinement mechanism is designed to identify dynamically critical regions and extract fine-grained geometric and motion cues at the local level.

title: D-Nav: End-to-End Dynamic UAV Navigation with Dual-Resolution Motion Awareness
sentence: This formulation enables the policy to reason about both large-scale dynamic context and small, irregular, fast-moving obstacles in complex dynamic environments.

title: D-Nav: End-to-End Dynamic UAV Navigation with Dual-Resolution Motion Awareness
sentence: In addition, D-Nav introduces a new mission-aware waypoint-goal condition mechanism that explicitly guides the policy to balance collision avoidance with the need to traverse task-critical regions.

title: D-Nav: End-to-End Dynamic UAV Navigation with Dual-Resolution Motion Awareness
sentence: Extensive simulations demonstrate a significant improvement in navigation success, increasing from 0.37 to 0.56 in complex dynamic environments.

title: D-Nav: End-to-End Dynamic UAV Navigation with Dual-Resolution Motion Awareness
sentence: Real-world experiments further validate the robustness and real-time capability of the proposed system across diverse dynamic scenarios.

title: D-Nav: End-to-End Dynamic UAV Navigation with Dual-Resolution Motion Awareness

title: Learning When to Jump for Off-road Navigation
sentence: Low speed does not always guarantee safety in off-road driving.

title: Learning When to Jump for Off-road Navigation
sentence: For instance, crossing a ditch may be risky at a low speed due to the risk of getting stuck, yet safe at a higher speed with a controlled, accelerated jump.

title: Learning When to Jump for Off-road Navigation
sentence: Achieving such behavior requires path planning that explicitly models complex motion dynamics, whereas existing methods often neglect this aspect and plan solely based on positions or a fixed velocity.

title: Learning When to Jump for Off-road Navigation
sentence: To address this gap, we introduce Motion-aware Traversability (MAT) representation to explicitly model terrain cost conditioned on actual robot motion.

title: Learning When to Jump for Off-road Navigation
sentence: Instead of assigning a single scalar score for traversability, MAT models each terrain region as a Gaussian function of velocity.

title: Learning When to Jump for Off-road Navigation
sentence: During online planning, we decompose the terrain cost computation into two stages: (1) predict terrain-dependent Gaussian parameters from perception in a single forward pass, (2) efficiently update terrain costs for new velocities inferred from current dynamics by evaluating these functions without repeated inference.

title: Learning When to Jump for Off-road Navigation
sentence: We develop a system that integrates MAT to enable agile off-road navigation and evaluate it in both simulated and real-world environments with various obstacles.

title: Learning When to Jump for Off-road Navigation
sentence: Results show that MAT achieves real-time efficiency and enhances the performance of off-road navigation, reducing path detours by 75% while maintaining safety across challenging terrains.

title: OpenFrontier: General Navigation with Visual-Language Grounded Frontiers
sentence: Open-world navigation requires robots to make decisions in complex everyday environments while adapting to flexible task requirements.

title: OpenFrontier: General Navigation with Visual-Language Grounded Frontiers
sentence: Conventional navigation approaches often rely on dense 3D reconstruction and hand-crafted goal metrics, which limits their generalization across tasks and environments.

title: OpenFrontier: General Navigation with Visual-Language Grounded Frontiers
sentence: Recent advances in vision-language navigation (VLN) and vision-language-action (VLA) models enable end-to-end policies conditioned on natural language, but typically require interactive training, large-scale data collection, or task-specific fine-tuning with a mobile agent.

title: OpenFrontier: General Navigation with Visual-Language Grounded Frontiers
sentence: We formulate navigation as a sparse subgoal identification and reaching problem and observe that providing visual anchoring targets for high-level semantic priors enables highly efficient goal-conditioned navigation.

title: OpenFrontier: General Navigation with Visual-Language Grounded Frontiers
sentence: Based on this insight, we select navigation frontiers as semantic anchors and propose OpenFrontier, a training-free navigation framework that seamlessly integrates diverse vision-language prior models.

title: OpenFrontier: General Navigation with Visual-Language Grounded Frontiers
sentence: OpenFrontier enables efficient navigation with a simple system design, without dense 3D mapping, policy training, or model fine-tuning.

title: OpenFrontier: General Navigation with Visual-Language Grounded Frontiers
sentence: We evaluate OpenFrontier across multiple navigation benchmarks and demonstrate strong zero-shot performance, as well as effective real-world deployment on a mobile robot.

title: LongNav-R1: Horizon-Adaptive Multi-Turn RL for Long-Horizon VLA Navigation
sentence: This paper develops LongNav-R1, an end-to-end multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) framework designed to optimize Visual-Language-Action (VLA) models for long-horizon navigation.

title: LongNav-R1: Horizon-Adaptive Multi-Turn RL for Long-Horizon VLA Navigation
sentence: Unlike existing single-turn paradigm, LongNav-R1 reformulates the navigation decision process as a continuous multi-turn conversation between the VLA policy and the embodied environment.

title: LongNav-R1: Horizon-Adaptive Multi-Turn RL for Long-Horizon VLA Navigation
sentence: This multi-turn RL framework offers two distinct advantages: i) it enables the agent to reason about the causal effects of historical interactions and sequential future outcomes; and ii) it allows the model to learn directly from online interactions, fostering diverse trajectory generation and avoiding the behavioral rigidity often imposed by human demonstrations.

title: LongNav-R1: Horizon-Adaptive Multi-Turn RL for Long-Horizon VLA Navigation
sentence: Furthermore, we introduce Horizon-Adaptive Policy Optimization.

title: LongNav-R1: Horizon-Adaptive Multi-Turn RL for Long-Horizon VLA Navigation
sentence: This mechanism explicitly accounts for varying horizon lengths during advantage estimation, facilitating accurate temporal credit assignment over extended sequences.

title: LongNav-R1: Horizon-Adaptive Multi-Turn RL for Long-Horizon VLA Navigation
sentence: Consequently, the agent develops diverse navigation behaviors and resists collapse during long-horizon tasks.

title: LongNav-R1: Horizon-Adaptive Multi-Turn RL for Long-Horizon VLA Navigation
